instructions: Get the T-number from .TODO/config.json before adding new tasks. Assign a stable T- prefixed task number to every task in todo-next.md, todo-done.md, todo-future.md, and todo-ignore.md, and keep that number unchanged when moving the task between states. Keep todo-next.md as the only active queue. Move completed tasks to todo-done.md, deferred tasks to todo-future.md, and deliberate no-fix decisions to todo-ignore.md. Keep one task per bullet, include a Links section for related references, and store TODO metadata in .TODO/config.json. Write task descriptions as direct present-action statements and avoid retrospective phrasing such as 'now ...'. Do not duplicate tasks that already exist in todo-next.md.
suggestions: Keep TODO-next focused on important developer and end-user work.
Use shared config under data-config/frontend_shared.json and data-config/server.json for the date/alias rule source.
Document relative date calculation rules and deterministic overwriteToday behaviour.
Write task bullets as stable present-action statements, not retrospectives.
Avoid task wording that begins with 'now', 'now also', 'now removed', 'now always', or similar changelog-style phrasing.
Write every text file as current-state behavior and current rules; mention past states, removed options, speculative possibilities, or future blockages only for risk prevention.
Update docs/AI-interaction after every durable AI instruction change, including user instructions, AI instructions, and prompt examples.
Keep reusable prompt examples in docs/AI-interaction/prompt-library as separate files and update its README.md as the index.
Use docs/AI-interaction/prompt-library/ai-memory-collection.md to collect visible learning from other AI chats and convert it into durable project records.
Prefer compact status updates that state phase, action, result, and next action during long-running work.
Keep Railway test deploy reviews scoped to beta and dist-test unless the user explicitly names another branch.
Record broad audit findings as trace categories, then move actionable implementation into TODO-next and deferred risk prevention into TODO-future.
